# Slay the Bear

> A memecoin and a town game in one NEAR testnet contract. Players burn $SLAY (NEP-141) to hit the
> Bear before a deadline; if the town's damage reaches its health, raiders split the Bear's hoard
> and a treasury reward by damage; if not, the Bear steals from the treasury. The Bear's tactic
> and the item drops (NEP-245) come from the drand quicknet beacon, verified on-chain with NEAR's
> BLS12-381 host functions. Built at NEAR HACKATHON for the memecoins and games tracks.

Live contract: game.slaythebear.testnet (NEAR testnet), code hash BD2jeytgDSV5wAyhNEfieVoFg3oqx9vedWuXZusPqdzN, reproducible build of commit b9f0a5b.

## Run and check

- `npm install`, then `npm test` (38 TypeScript tests) and `npm run test:contract` (16 Rust tests, needs Rust + cargo-near)
- `npm run verify:game`: recomputes every settled raid of the live contract from its views and drand; prints PASS/FAIL
- `npm run verify:live`: deployed code hash vs a local reproducible build, access keys, config preset
- `npm run demo`: web app at http://localhost:3000 (live town read-only, plus an offline simulation)
- `npm run simulate`: economy simulation, writes sim-out/report.html

## Play from a terminal

- `./slay help` (`.\slay help` in PowerShell), after `npm install`: the rules in a minute and every command
- `./slay sim demo`: one whole offline raid, command by command
- `./slay sim <command>`: an offline town with the same rules engine, villagers and a local test beacon; its clock moves only on `wait`
- `./slay live <command>`: the testnet game; `./slay live join --site <hosted demo URL>` makes a free guest, `--account <id.testnet>` signs with your key from ~/.near-credentials
- Commands: status, hit <1-1000> [--weapon club|sword|slayer], wait <seconds|end>, settle, claim, me, craft, smith, market, sell, buy, cancel, feed, raids, verify [raid], rules
- `--json` prints one object: ok, result, status (raid, you, town, next) or error, message, hint; exit code 0 done, 1 a failed move or check, 2 a usage error
- [docs/CLI.md](docs/CLI.md): the commands, the JSON, time and saved state

## Key files

- [contracts/game/src/lib.rs](contracts/game/src/lib.rs): the contract: raids, settlement, items, market, smith, feed
- [contracts/game/src/drand.rs](contracts/game/src/drand.rs): on-chain drand quicknet BLS verification (hash-to-field, map to G1, pairing)
- [contracts/game/src/rules.rs](contracts/game/src/rules.rs): all formulas, including the Bear's mood and tactic draw
- [packages/rules/src/engine.ts](packages/rules/src/engine.ts): the same state machine in TypeScript
- [packages/rules/src/verify.ts](packages/rules/src/verify.ts): per-raid verification
- [packages/rules/src/npc.ts](packages/rules/src/npc.ts): NPC rules in words (Bear mood, smith, villager personalities)
- [packages/rules/src/town.ts](packages/rules/src/town.ts): the offline town, used by the web app's offline mode and the CLI
- [packages/cli/src/commands.ts](packages/cli/src/commands.ts): the terminal client's commands, written once for the offline town and the testnet game
- [fixtures/vectors.json](fixtures/vectors.json): scripted game replayed by both implementations
- [apps/web](apps/web): Next.js app; app/api/relay/route.ts is the meta-transaction relayer
